amendment_reason: Policy v1 used exact equality for every unclassified number and matched the word overflow before recognizing the _s unit. ORFS and OpenROAD report wall time, CPU time, stage timers, and peak memory alongside scientific metrics. Those execution observations depend on host scheduling and resource allocation and are not deterministic scientific outputs. Policy v2 retains them and their raw hashes for audit while gating the scientific state separately.
freeze_rule: The policy, comparator, producer catalogue, closed metric schema, immutable-input manifest, command manifest, adjudication, and runner must be hashed and made read-only before either fresh run directory is created.

required: OCI image digest and image ID
ORFS commit, tree, recursive submodules, and reconciled execution subset
GCD RTL, configuration, SDC, platform scripts, and SKY130HD collateral
runner, environment settings, and official make command

canonicalization.absolute_run_roots: replace only recognized Gate 03E/03E-R run roots with the frozen token
canonicalization.netlist: structural JSON emitted by the exact-hashed pinned Yosys plus exact parsed mapped-master histogram
canonicalization.def: conservative complete token stream with no scientific-field removal
canonicalization.sdc: conservative complete token stream with no constraint removal
canonicalization.spef: conservative complete token stream with only the SPEF DATE record replaced
canonicalization.klayout_lyt: XML C14N after replacing only a recognized run-root prefix inside reader-options/lefdef/lef-files

failure_conditions: missing or additional artifact or metric
technology XML mismatch outside the one predeclared run-root substitution
